_comment_format: Mempool-style pool database. coinbase_tags map a substring of a coinbase scriptSig.coin (or coinbase output OP_RETURN) to a pool. payout_addresses map a coinbase output address to a pool. The mining indexer joins blocks to pools via these. For B3Chain testnet the only known miner is the solo b3chain-pool stratum on seed1; everything else is binned as 'Unknown'. Update as real pools come online.
